messages:
Leah Kim: Thanks all for coming — quick live thread for any follow-ups on positioning and GTM priorities.
Omar Vyas: Love the session. Quick clarity ask: is our north star still "inference predictability" or should we lead with "unit economics" for sales decks?
Leah Kim: Short answer: keep inference predictability as the mission anchor; lead with unit economics for buyer-specific collateral. Two-tier message: mission = predictable inference; tactical = cost & reliability for infra buyers.
Priya Nair: For product prioritization, should PMs bias roadmaps toward features that reduce $/token (e.g., quant/auto-batching) or features that expand enterprise contracts (e.g., dedicated regions, compliance)?
Leah Kim: Bias toward near-term margin wins that help hosted customers (quant, caching) while keeping a parallel ship for enterprise (Dedicated scaling + compliance).
Elena Gomez: Competitor callout: are we explicitly naming the big clouds in messaging or sticking to capability comparisons? Sales wants a short battlecard.
Leah Kim: Don't call them out by name in public marketing; sales enablement will get a private battlecard with direct comparisons and rebuttals. @Elena we'll sync on the deck.
Sam Carter: Hiring/product ops question: will we pause any new platform initiatives to meet the Q target, or is it more about reprioritizing work?
Leah Kim: No hiring freeze. It's a prioritization shift: freeze low-impact experiments, reallocate a few sprints to Optimize and SLA work.
Omar Vyas: What's the expectation for measurable impact by quarter-end? A target delta for $/1M tokens or p95?
Leah Kim: Target: 10-15% unit-cost improvement on average for hosted workloads and p95 latency < 250ms for top-tier routes. We'll put exact %s in the OKR doc.
allhands-bot: Slides + recording here: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1771001234
Priya Nair: Thanks, can we also get the persona one-pagers and the private battlecard when ready?
Leah Kim: Yes — persona 1-pagers + sales battlecard by EOD Friday. I'll post follow-ups in this thread. Appreciate the questions. :sparkles:
